objective: Determine whether request-local terminal evidence handles improve GLM-5.3-flash context selection at 8K within cumulative input-plus-output tokens.

claim_ceiling: The evidence supports token-efficient terminal context selection for GLM-5.3-flash at the 8K experimental window. It does not establish code-repair correctness, larger-window behavior, non-code transfer, other-model transfer, or a default production policy.

successor: Begin the next separately registered milestone: test the confirmed mechanism at larger GLM context windows, then connect context selection to completed-outcome correctness and non-code transfer.
